description: Four ivory horns splayed from one base, ridged like bark. Fiends and wraiths grow them for arguments they win.
lore: Twenty-four gold, and the honest bone in it is worth about two. What you are buying is the outline — four horns off one base, ridged like bark, and no other arrangement of plain bone in this country reads as hard as that across a room. The traders know precisely what they have. It goes high on the stack, three-quarters on, with the light coming up under it.

It is the newly woken who buy them. A man three weeks into a country that is not the one he expected will not spend on a blanket and will spend on this, and hang it on a wall he does not own, in a room he will not keep, and it works — it is the first thing here that is his. [[characters/6bb1eb5a|Solveig]] has watched that happen a hundred times from the fire, and has never once talked anybody out of it.
gm_notes: Junk priced on silhouette, sold to the newly woken. Solveig's refusal to intervene is the same courtesy as meeting a waking, applied to a bad purchase.
